newsitem.title: CHINA: China Taikang insurance plans branch companies.
newsitem.headline: China Taikang insurance plans branch companies.

text.p: China's fledgling Taikang Life Insurance Co Ltd expects to generate income of at least 400 million yuan ($48 million) in 1997 and to open branch firms in four major cities, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

The Beijing-based insurer, which was approved by the People's Bank of China -- the central bank -- in August last year, generated 150 million yuan ($18 million) in premium income in its first four months of operation, the agency said.

Premium income had risen further since the begining of the year and Taikang planned to open branch companies in the cities of Shanghai, southern Guangzhou, southwestern Chongqing and northeastern Shenyang, it said.

It quoted experts as saying total output of China's life insurance industry would reach 120 billion yuan by 2000, and predicted the number of Chinese insurance companies would increase sharply in 1997, benefiting consumers.
